# BudgetFlow — Privacy-First Personal Finance Tracker for Google Sheets

> BudgetFlow is a modern, self-hosted personal finance web application powered by the user's own Google Sheets and Google Drive. It provides a sleek interactive dashboard for tracking income, expenses, monthly category budgets, savings goals, debt payoff, and net worth for a $15 one-time payment—with zero monthly subscriptions and no bank credential sharing required.

## Quick Facts & Product Summary
- **Product Name:** BudgetFlow
- **Category:** Personal Finance Software / Google Sheets Budget Tracker / YNAB & Mint Alternative
- **Official Website:** https://personal-finance.mstudio.fun/
- **Purchase / Download URL:** https://mstudiofun.gumroad.com/l/nkrgwd
- **Pricing:** $15 USD one-time payment (67% off regular $45 price). Lifetime license, $0/month, free lifetime updates.
- **Data Storage & Privacy:** 100% self-hosted inside the user's personal Google Drive (Google Sheets) via Google Apps Script. Zero external servers, zero third-party data harvesting, no Plaid or bank login required.
- **Supported Platforms:** Any modern web browser on macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android.

## Core Features
- **Interactive Dashboard:** Real-time monthly income, expenses, net savings rate, net worth calculation, and cash flow bar/doughnut charts.
- **Quick-Add Transaction Tracker:** Log and filter income/expense transactions by category, type, and date in seconds.
- **Automated Monthly Budgets:** Set category spending limits (Food & Drink, Transport, Shopping, Bills, Entertainment) with visual percentage progress bars.
- **Savings Goals & Milestones:** Track progress toward Emergency Funds, Vacation, or Home Down Payments with target dates.
- **Debt & Loan Payoff Manager:** Monitor mortgages, car loans, interest rates (p.a.), remaining balances, and repayment progress.
- **Assets & Net Worth Calculator:** Track property, stock/ETF portfolios, cash, and gold reserves with automatic portfolio share percentages.

## How BudgetFlow Works (3-Step Setup Architecture)
1. **Step 1 — Create a Google Sheet:** Open Google Sheets in your personal Google account, paste the included BudgetFlow Google Apps Script backend code, and click "Deploy as Web App" in 2 clicks.
2. **Step 2 — Connect BudgetFlow UI:** Paste your unique Google Apps Script Web App URL into the BudgetFlow application. Your browser communicates directly with your Google Sheet.
3. **Step 3 — Start Tracking Privately:** Add transactions, monitor monthly budgets, track savings milestones, and calculate net worth with full data sovereignty.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Is BudgetFlow really a $15 one-time payment with no subscription?
Yes. You pay $15 once (discounted 67% from the regular $45 price) and own BudgetFlow forever. There are no monthly fees, no annual renewals, and all future product updates are included free of charge.

### How is BudgetFlow different from YNAB, Mint, or Monarch Money?
YNAB ($109/yr) and Monarch ($99/yr) charge recurring subscriptions and store your financial records and bank connections on their cloud servers. BudgetFlow gives you a modern interactive web dashboard powered by your own Google Sheet, saving you over $500 in 5 years while keeping your data 100% private.

### Where is my financial data stored and who can see it?
100% of your financial data lives inside a Google Sheet in your personal Google Drive account. BudgetFlow operates serverless via your own Google Apps Script deployment—meaning BudgetFlow never stores, accesses, tracks, or sells your data.

### Do I need to link my bank account or share bank passwords?
No. BudgetFlow is designed for intentional, privacy-first tracking without Plaid or bank credential sharing. Adding a transaction takes 5 seconds via the Quick-Add form, keeping your banking credentials 100% isolated from third-party breaches.

### Why use BudgetFlow instead of a plain Google Sheets budget template?
Traditional spreadsheet templates quickly become laggy, hard to read on mobile, and prone to broken formulas. BudgetFlow gives you a dedicated, responsive app interface with real-time Chart.js analytics, budget progress bars, debt calculators, and net worth tracking—while automatically writing every entry cleanly into your Google Sheet.
